findings.text: reuse: _pointer_ownership adds a second pointer-comparison normaliser beside the existing _changed_pointer_fields at pending_landing.py:165, which already owns the capability of treating a listing-versus-by-id shape difference as no change; the addition could have been expressed as _changed_pointer_fields(pointer_as_read(x), pointer_as_read(y)) and does not extend that owner.

evidence: the manifest's baseline_suite arm runs tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py and tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py, neither of which imports reckon.crew.pending_landing or reckon.crew.runs, so the done_when's 'the tests that import the changed modules add no failure against a base arm' is not measured by the recorded arm; the importing population is only covered by a head run (related-tests-head.log, 278 passed, 1 pre-existing failure) with a base spot-check of that one failure, and that head log carries no revision header or EXIT= line.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit 7ef523e33f against 4fa07b80a8: three files, +36/-7 and +7/-3 in production plus a 277-line test; both release passes now normalise before comparing and the ownerless pass keeps a live worker.
item_verdicts.done_when: tests/test_a_release_pass_ignores_the_listing_shape.py covers the slim-retirement, rewritten-pointer and live-worker cases plus a 22-pointer half-slim/half-whole census; its log records 5 passed at 7ef523e33f and the negative control records 4 failed with the pointer held at 4fa07b80a8.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that both release passes retire a promoted pointer with a dead worker whatever listing shape it was read in; reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:624 and :764 and runs.pointer_as_read at reckon/crew/runs.py:1914 are the change.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the source manifest; it states status complete, both suite arms green (58 -> 63 passed, 0 failed), and the negative control failing at base, with log paths under the run directory.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the delivered diff touches only reckon/crew/pending_landing.py, reckon/crew/runs.py and the new test, every path inside the declared set; the declared evidence-fragment and figure paths were not written and are not required by the done_when.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_release_pass_ignores_the_listing_shape.py:172 and :187 fail at the base revision (negative-control.log) and the retirement assertions check pointer-file absence, an independent side effect.
justifications.evidence: the new test covers all three done_when cases and the 22-pointer census with a negative control at 4fa07b80a8 that fails with the pointer held (negative-control.log EXIT=1), though the recorded base arm runs tests that do not import the changed modules.
justifications.fit: the helper, its docstrings and the public pointer_as_read rename follow the surrounding style of reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:193 and reckon/crew/runs.py:1914, with no forbidden name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:624 and :764 compare each record through _pointer_ownership, so a promoted dead-worker pointer listed slim is retired while a rewritten or live-worker one is kept.
justifications.reuse: the addition reuses runs.pointer_as_read and _OBSERVATION_FIELDS but adds _pointer_ownership at reckon/crew/pending_landing.py:193 beside the existing _changed_pointer_fields at :165 rather than expressing it through :165.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches only reckon/crew/pending_landing.py, reckon/crew/runs.py and tests/test_a_release_pass_ignores_the_listing_shape.py, all inside the declared write paths.
